newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 2.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 2.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
-- Polish Prime Minister Wlodzimierz Cimoszewicz has arrived for one-day visit to Budapest.
-- Prime Minister Gyula Horn will receive US Republican senators on Thursday, ahead of the a NATO decision on the organisation's enlargement.
-- Prime Minister Gyula Horn will attend the summit of NATO partners next week in Madrid.

-- A committee investigating a privatisation scandal over irregular payments to an advisor of the state privatisation agency APV, has completed its work and the results should be published, said Laszlo Toller, head of ruling Socialist Party MPs' fraction in parliament.
